message.content:
1.  **Text Clipping in Attribution Bar**: The text "© OpenStreetMap contributors | OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap" in the bottom-center attribution bar is horizontally clipped on both the left and right sides, cutting off the copyright symbols and the final characters of "OpenStreetMap".  
2.  **Insufficient Contrast for Secondary Text**: The helper text "Photos never leave this device — matching, EXIF writing, and the ZIP all happen in your browser." at the very bottom of the right panel has a contrast ratio that appears to be below the WCAG AA standard (4.5:1) against the dark charcoal background.
